- Complete “Jardin,” a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the static entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Prior syntax checks passed for `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/i18n.js`.
- Traced APIs, DOM structure, and exports needed to wire the game entry module.

### Active
- Implement `js/game.js` to connect title/setup, starter selection, gameplay rendering and movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saving, language switching, and ending/game-over flows.
- Fix the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import in `js/ui.js` and validate module compatibility.
- Test gameplay, language rendering, and desktop/mobile behavior.

### Blocked
- `index.html` references missing `js/game.js`, preventing the app from starting.
- `js/ui.js` imports `formatTimeSafe` from `js/core.js`, but that export does not exist.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js` and connect the title screen, world, battle, UI, and save systems.
2. Remove or correct the invalid import and check all module imports/exports.
3. Run syntax/import checks and test language selection and desktop/mobile gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Title/setup UI, gameplay DOM, and game entry script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Missing entry module required by `index.html`.
- `js/core.js`: State, saves, party/items, mode settings, hooks, and audio utilities.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle and capture systems; exports `startBattle(opts)`.
- `js/ui.js`: Game panels, `uiHooks`, and language refresh logic.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, entities, arenas, rendering, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive title screen, game HUD, battle, and modal styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.
- `js/lang/`: Ten language dictionaries.
- `js/pokedata.js`: Generated species, move, type, and evolution data.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `GardenWorld` provides `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; actor coordinates are pixels.
- NPCs and arenas are exposed as `world.npcs[]` and `world.arenas[]`; arena definitions include tile coordinates and pixel positions.
- `uiHooks` must be connected by the app for world lookup, fast travel, saving, title navigation, retry/new run, language changes, and item use/purchase.
- Battle completion is wired through `hooks.onBattleEnd`; `startBattle(opts)` switches between `#gameScreen` and `#battleScreen`.
- `js/core.js` exports `createState`, `saveGame`, `loadGame`, and related state helpers, but not `formatTimeSafe`.

## Objective
- Complete Jardin, a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the static entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Prior syntax checks passed for `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/i18n.js`.
- Inspected the entry screen, world, battle, UI, core, and translation APIs to map the missing app wiring.

### Active
- Implement `js/game.js` to connect title/setup, starter selection, gameplay rendering and movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saving, language switching, and ending/game-over flows.
- Fix the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import in `js/ui.js` and validate module compatibility.
- Test gameplay, language rendering, and desktop/mobile behavior.

### Blocked
- `index.html` references missing `js/game.js`, preventing the app from starting.
- `js/ui.js` imports `formatTimeSafe` from `js/core.js`, but that export does not exist.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js` and connect the title screen, world, battle, UI, and save systems.
2. Remove or correct the invalid import and check all module imports/exports.
3. Run syntax/import checks and test language selection and desktop/mobile gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, gameplay DOM, and game entry script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Missing entry module required by `index.html`.
- `js/core.js`: State, saves, party/items, mode settings, hooks, and audio utilities.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle and capture systems; exports `startBattle(opts)`.
- `js/ui.js`: Game panels, `uiHooks`, and language refresh logic.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, entities, arenas, rendering, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive title screen, game HUD, battle, and modal styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.
- `js/lang/`: Ten language dictionaries.
- `js/pokedata.js`: Generated species, move, type, and evolution data.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `GardenWorld` provides `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; actor coordinates are pixels.
- NPCs and arenas are exposed as `world.npcs[]` and `world.arenas[]`; arena definitions include tile coordinates and pixel positions.
- `uiHooks` must be connected by the app for world lookup, fast travel, saving, title navigation, retry/new run, language changes, and item use/purchase.
- Battle completion is wired through `hooks.onBattleEnd`; `startBattle(opts)` switches between `#gameScreen` and `#battleScreen`.
- `js/core.js` exports `createState`, `saveGame`, `loadGame`, and related state helpers, but not `formatTimeSafe`.

## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the static entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Prior syntax checks passed for `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/i18n.js`.
- Inspected app DOM and module APIs to map the required wiring.

### Active
- Implement `js/game.js` to connect title/setup, starter selection, gameplay rendering and movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saving, language switching, and ending/game-over flows.
- Fix the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import in `js/ui.js` and validate module compatibility.
- Test gameplay, language rendering, and desktop/mobile behavior.

### Blocked
- `index.html` references missing `js/game.js`, preventing the app from starting.
- `js/ui.js` imports `formatTimeSafe` from `js/core.js`, but that export does not exist.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js` and connect the title screen, world, battle, UI, and save systems.
2. Remove or correct the invalid import and check all module imports/exports.
3. Run syntax/import checks and test language selection and desktop/mobile gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, gameplay DOM, and game entry script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Missing entry module required by `index.html`.
- `js/core.js`: State, saves, party/items, mode settings, hooks, and audio utilities.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle and capture systems; exports `startBattle(opts)`.
- `js/ui.js`: Game panels, `uiHooks`, and invalid import.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, entities, arenas, rendering, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive title screen, game HUD, battle, and modal styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.
- `js/lang/`: Ten language dictionaries.
- `js/pokedata.js`: Generated species, move, type, and evolution data.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `GardenWorld` provides `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; actor coordinates are pixels.
- NPCs and arenas are exposed as `world.npcs[]` and `world.arenas[]`; arena definitions include tile coordinates and pixel positions.
- Connect `uiHooks` for world lookup, fast travel, saving, title navigation, retry/new run, language changes, and item use/purchase.
- Battle completion is wired through `hooks.onBattleEnd`; `startBattle(opts)` switches between `#gameScreen` and `#battleScreen`.
- `js/core.js` exports `createState`, `saveGame`, `loadGame`, and related state helpers, but not `formatTimeSafe`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the static entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Prior syntax checks passed for `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/i18n.js`.
- Inspected app DOM and module APIs to map the required wiring.

### Active
- Implement `js/game.js` to connect title/setup, starter selection, gameplay rendering and movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saving, language switching, and ending/game-over flows.
- Fix the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import in `js/ui.js` and validate module compatibility.
- Test gameplay, language rendering, and desktop/mobile behavior.

### Blocked
- `index.html` references missing `js/game.js`, preventing the app from starting.
- `js/ui.js` imports `formatTimeSafe` from `js/core.js`, but that export does not exist.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js` and connect the title screen, world, battle, UI, and save systems.
2. Remove or correct the invalid import and check all module imports/exports.
3. Run syntax/import checks and test language selection and desktop/mobile gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, gameplay DOM, and game entry script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Missing entry module required by `index.html`.
- `js/core.js`: State, saves, party/items, mode settings, hooks, and audio utilities.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle and capture systems; exports `startBattle(opts)`.
- `js/ui.js`: Game panels, `uiHooks`, and invalid import.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, entities, arenas, rendering, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive title screen, game HUD, battle, and modal styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.
- `js/lang/`: Ten language dictionaries.
- `js/pokedata.js`: Generated species, move, type, and evolution data.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `GardenWorld` provides `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; actor coordinates are pixels.
- NPCs and arenas are exposed as `world.npcs[]` and `world.arenas[]`; arena definitions include tile coordinates and pixel positions.
- Connect `uiHooks` for world lookup, fast travel, saving, title navigation, retry/new run, language changes, and item use/purchase.
- Battle completion is wired through `hooks.onBattleEnd`; `startBattle(opts)` switches between `#gameScreen` and `#battleScreen`.
- `js/core.js` exports `createState`, `saveGame`, `loadGame`, and related state helpers, but not `formatTimeSafe`.

## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the static entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Prior syntax checks passed for `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/i18n.js`.
- Inspected app DOM and module APIs to map the required wiring.

### Active
- Implement `js/game.js` to connect title/setup, starter selection, gameplay rendering and movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saving, language switching, and ending/game-over flows.
- Fix the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import in `js/ui.js` and check module compatibility.
- Test gameplay, language rendering, and desktop/mobile behavior.

### Blocked
- `index.html` references missing `js/game.js`, preventing the app from starting.
- `js/ui.js` imports `formatTimeSafe` from `js/core.js`, but that export does not exist.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js` and connect title/setup, world, battle, UI, and save systems.
2. Remove or correct the invalid import and check all module imports/exports.
3. Run syntax/import checks and test language selection and desktop/mobile gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, gameplay DOM, and game entry script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Missing entry module required by `index.html`.
- `js/core.js`: State, saves, party/items, mode settings, hooks, and audio utilities.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle and capture systems; exports `startBattle(opts)`.
- `js/ui.js`: Game panels, `uiHooks`, and invalid import.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, entities, arenas, rendering, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive title screen, game HUD, battle, and modal styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.
- `js/lang/`: Ten language dictionaries.
- `js/pokedata.js`: Generated species, move, type, and evolution data.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `GardenWorld` provides `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; actor coordinates are pixels.
- NPCs and arenas are exposed as `world.npcs[]` and `world.arenas[]`; arena definitions include tile coordinates and pixel positions.
- Connect `uiHooks` for world lookup, fast travel, saving, title navigation, retry/new run, language changes, and item use/purchase.
- Battle completion is wired through `hooks.onBattleEnd`; `startBattle(opts)` switches between `#gameScreen` and `#battleScreen`.
- `js/core.js` exports `createState`, `saveGame`, `loadGame`, and related state helpers, but not `formatTimeSafe`.

## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the static entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Prior syntax checks passed for `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/i18n.js`.
- Inspected setup/game DOM, world/NPC/arena APIs, core exports, battle startup, and UI hooks to plan runtime wiring.

### Active
- Implement `js/game.js`, referenced by `index.html` but still missing, to connect title/setup, starter selection, gameplay rendering and movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saving, language switching, and ending/game-over flows.
- Fix the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import in `js/ui.js` and check module compatibility.
- Test gameplay, language rendering, and desktop/mobile behavior.

### Blocked
- `index.html` references missing `js/game.js`, preventing the app from starting.
- `js/ui.js` imports `formatTimeSafe` from `js/core.js`, but that export does not exist.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js` to wire title/setup, world, battle, UI, and save systems.
2. Remove or correct the invalid import and check all module imports/exports.
3. Run syntax/import checks and test language selection and desktop/mobile gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, gameplay DOM, and game entry script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Missing entry module required by `index.html`.
- `js/core.js`: State, saves, party/items, mode settings, hooks, and audio utilities.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle and capture systems; exports `startBattle(opts)`.
- `js/ui.js`: Game panels, `uiHooks`, and invalid import.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, entities, arenas, rendering, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive title screen, game HUD, battle, and modal styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.
- `js/lang/`: Ten language dictionaries.
- `js/pokedata.js`: Generated species, move, type, and evolution data.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` starts at pixel position `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`; player coordinates are pixels.
- `GardenWorld` provides `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; entities include `world.npcs[]` and `world.arenas[]`.
- `uiHooks` need wiring for world lookup, fast travel, saving, title navigation, retry/new run, language changes, and item use/purchase.
- Battle completion is wired through `hooks.onBattleEnd`; `startBattle(opts)` switches between `#gameScreen` and `#battleScreen`.
- `formatTimeSafe` is unused in `js/ui.js`; the UI imports `formatTime` from `js/i18n.js`.

## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the static entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Prior syntax checks passed for `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/i18n.js`.
- Inspected DOM structure and core, battle, UI, and world APIs to plan runtime wiring.

### Active
- Implement `js/game.js`, referenced by `index.html`, to connect title/setup, starter selection, gameplay rendering and movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saving, language switching, and ending/game-over flows.
- Check module imports/exports and test gameplay, language rendering, and desktop/mobile behavior.

### Blocked
- `index.html` references missing `js/game.js`, preventing the app from starting.
- `js/ui.js` imports `formatTimeSafe` from `js/core.js`, but that export does not exist.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js` to wire title/setup, world, battle, UI, and save systems.
2. Remove or correct the invalid import and check all module imports/exports.
3. Run syntax/import checks and test language selection and desktop/mobile gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, gameplay DOM, and game entry script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Missing entry module required by `index.html`.
- `js/core.js`: State, saves, party/items, mode settings, hooks, and audio utilities.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle and capture systems; exports `startBattle(opts)`.
- `js/ui.js`: Game panels, `uiHooks`, and invalid import.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, entities, arenas, rendering, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive title screen, game HUD, battle, and modal styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.
- `js/lang/`: Ten language dictionaries.
- `js/pokedata.js`: Generated species, move, type, and evolution data.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` starts at pixel position `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`; player coordinates are pixels.
- `GardenWorld` provides `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; entities include `world.npcs[]` and `world.arenas[]`.
- `uiHooks` need wiring for world lookup, fast travel, saving, title navigation, retry/new run, language changes, and item use/purchase.
- Battle completion is wired through `hooks.onBattleEnd`; `startBattle(opts)` switches between `#gameScreen` and `#battleScreen`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the static entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Prior syntax checks passed for `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/i18n.js`.
- Inspected runtime APIs and DOM needed to connect the game entry module.

### Active
- Implement `js/game.js` to wire title/setup, starter selection, world rendering and movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saving, language switching, and game-ending flows.
- Check module imports/exports, then test gameplay and language rendering.

### Blocked
- `index.html` references missing `js/game.js`, preventing startup.
- `js/ui.js` imports `formatTimeSafe` from `js/core.js`, but that export does not exist.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js`, including the animation loop and setup, interaction, touch, and UI-hook wiring.
2. Remove or correct the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import and verify imports/exports.
3. Run syntax/import checks and test language selection and desktop/mobile gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, gameplay DOM, and game entry script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Missing entry module required by `index.html`.
- `js/core.js`: State, saves, party/items, mode settings, hooks, and audio utilities.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle and capture systems; exports `startBattle(opts)`.
- `js/ui.js`: Game panels, `uiHooks`, and invalid import.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, rendering, NPCs, arenas, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive title screen, game HUD, battle, and modal styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `js/lang/`: Ten language dictionaries.
- `js/pokedata.js`: Generated species, move, type, and evolution data.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` starts at pixel position `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`; player coordinates are pixels.
- `GardenWorld` provides `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; instances have `npcs[]` and `arenas[]`.
- `uiHooks` need wiring for world lookup, fast travel, saving, title navigation, retry/new run, language changes, and item use/purchase.
- Battle completion uses `hooks.onBattleEnd`; `startBattle(opts)` switches between `#gameScreen` and `#battleScreen`.
- `GardenWorld` is exported from `js/world.js`; `encounterPool(zoneId, randomize, rng)` is also exported.

## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the static entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Prior syntax checks passed for `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/i18n.js`.
- Inspected runtime APIs and DOM needed to connect the game entry module.

### Active
- Implement `js/game.js` to wire title/setup, starter selection, world rendering and movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saving, language switching, and game-ending flows.
- Check module imports/exports, then test gameplay and language rendering.

### Blocked
- `index.html` references missing `js/game.js`, preventing startup.
- `js/ui.js` imports `formatTimeSafe` from `js/core.js`, but that export does not exist.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js`, including the animation loop and setup, interaction, touch, and UI-hook wiring.
2. Remove or correct the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import and verify imports/exports.
3. Run syntax/import checks and test language selection and desktop/mobile gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, gameplay DOM, and game entry script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Missing entry module required by `index.html`.
- `js/core.js`: State, saves, party/items, mode settings, hooks, and audio utilities.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle and capture systems; exports `startBattle(opts)`.
- `js/ui.js`: Game panels, `uiHooks`, and invalid import.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, rendering, NPCs, arenas, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive title screen, game HUD, battle, and modal styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `js/lang/`: Ten language dictionaries.
- `js/pokedata.js`: Generated species, move, type, and evolution data.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` starts at pixel position `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`; player coordinates are pixels.
- `GardenWorld` provides `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; instances have `npcs[]` and `arenas[]`.
- `uiHooks` need wiring for world lookup, fast travel, saving, title navigation, retry/new run, language changes, and item use/purchase.
- Battle completion uses `hooks.onBattleEnd`; `startBattle(opts)` switches between `#gameScreen` and `#battleScreen`.

## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the static entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Prior syntax checks passed for `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/i18n.js`.
- Inspected runtime APIs and DOM needed to connect the game entry module.

### Active
- Implement `js/game.js` to connect setup, starter selection, world rendering and movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saving, language switching, and game-ending flows.
- Verify module imports/exports, then test gameplay and language rendering.

### Blocked
- `index.html` references missing `js/game.js`, preventing startup.
- `js/ui.js` imports `formatTimeSafe` from `js/core.js`, but that export does not exist.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js`, including animation loop and setup, interaction, touch, and UI-hook wiring.
2. Remove or correct the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import and verify imports/exports.
3. Run syntax/import checks and test language selection and desktop/mobile gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, gameplay DOM, and game entry script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Missing entry module required by `index.html`.
- `js/core.js`: State, saves, party/items, mode settings, hooks, and audio utilities.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle and capture systems; exports `startBattle(opts)`.
- `js/ui.js`: Game panels, `uiHooks`, and invalid import.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, rendering, NPCs, arenas, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive title screen, game HUD, battle, and modal styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `js/lang/`: Ten language dictionaries.
- `js/pokedata.js`: Generated species, move, type, and evolution data.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` starts at pixel position `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`; player coordinates are pixels.
- `GardenWorld` provides `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; instances have `npcs[]` and `arenas[]`.
- `uiHooks` need wiring for world lookup, fast travel, saving, title navigation, retry/new run, language changes, and item use/purchase.
- Battle completion uses `hooks.onBattleEnd`; `startBattle(opts)` switches between `#gameScreen` and `#battleScreen`.

## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the static entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Prior syntax checks passed for `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/i18n.js`.
- Inspected runtime APIs and DOM needed to connect the game entry module.

### Active
- Implement `js/game.js` to connect setup, starter selection, world rendering and movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saving, language switching, and game-ending flows.
- Verify module imports/exports, then test gameplay and language rendering.

### Blocked
- `index.html` references missing `js/game.js`, preventing startup.
- `js/ui.js` imports `formatTimeSafe` from `js/core.js`, but that export does not exist.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js`, including animation loop and setup, interaction, touch, and UI-hook wiring.
2. Remove or correct the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import and verify imports/exports.
3. Run syntax/import checks and test language selection and desktop/mobile gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, gameplay DOM, and game entry script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Missing entry module required by `index.html`.
- `js/core.js`: State, saves, party/items, mode settings, hooks, and audio utilities.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle and capture systems; exports `startBattle(opts)`.
- `js/ui.js`: Game panels, `uiHooks`, and invalid import.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, rendering, NPCs, arenas, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive title screen, game HUD, battle, and modal styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `js/lang/`: Ten language dictionaries.
- `js/pokedata.js`: Generated species, move, type, and evolution data.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` starts at pixel position `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`; player coordinates are pixels.
- `GardenWorld` provides `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; instances have `npcs[]` and `arenas[]`.
- `uiHooks` need wiring for world lookup, fast travel, saving, title navigation, retry/new run, language changes, and item use/purchase.
- Battle completion uses `hooks.onBattleEnd`; `startBattle(opts)` switches between `#gameScreen` and `#battleScreen`.

## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Prior syntax checks passed for core, battle, UI, world, and i18n modules.

### Active
- Implement `js/game.js` to connect setup, starter selection, movement/rendering, interactions, encounters, arenas, saving, language switching, and game-ending flows.
- Wire `uiHooks` and core battle hooks; verify gameplay and language rendering.

### Blocked
- `index.html` references missing `js/game.js`, preventing startup.
- `js/ui.js` imports nonexistent `formatTimeSafe` from `js/core.js`; needs removal or correction.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js`, including animation loop and setup, interaction, touch, and UI-hook wiring.
2. Remove or correct the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import and verify imports/exports.
3. Run syntax/import checks and test language selection and desktop/mobile gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, gameplay DOM, and game entry script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Missing entry module required by `index.html`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Implemented `js/game.js` startup, setup/starter selection, world rendering and movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saves, language switching, input/touch controls, and UI/battle hooks.
- Removed the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import from `js/ui.js`.
- `node --check` passes for `js/game.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/core.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/battle.js`.

### Active
- Validate runtime gameplay and correct mismatches between `game.js` and existing world/UI/battle APIs.

### Blocked
- Browser smoke test has not run: local HTTP server attempts exited on timeout, so Chromium could not connect.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and fix API mismatches in `js/game.js` (notably `GardenWorld.getDrawables()` returns props only; drawing code currently expects NPC/arena drawables).
2. Verify arena and battle completion result shapes, starter setup and UI hook behavior against existing implementations.
3. Run a local browser smoke test and test desktop/mobile controls, language selection, saving/loading, and gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, setup/starter UI, gameplay DOM, and game script reference.
- `js/game.js`: New game entry module and primary active integration work.
- `js/core.js`: State, mode options, saves, team/items, hooks, and audio APIs.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle flow and completion callback.
- `js/ui.js`: Panels and `uiHooks`.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, rendering, NPCs, arenas, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier checkpoint noted `tools/build-data.mjs` modified and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` untracked.
- `createState()` positions the player at pixel coordinates `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`.
- World exposes `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; instances have `npcs[]` and `arenas[]`.
- `getDrawables(cam)` currently returns nearby props only, so `game.js` must independently render nearby NPCs and arenas.
- `drawGround()` draws using world-space coordinates; `game.js` currently sets no camera transform before drawing, so confirm/correct camera translation.
- `world.drawMinimap` expects `discovered` as a `Set`; game state stores it as an array.
- Browser runtime verification remains outstanding.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Created `js/game.js` with setup, starter selection, movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saves, language switching, input/touch controls, and UI/battle hooks.
- Removed the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import from `js/ui.js`.
- `node --check` passes for `js/game.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/core.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/battle.js`.

### Active
- Validate runtime gameplay and correct integration mismatches between `js/game.js` and existing world/UI/battle APIs.

### Blocked
- Browser smoke test remains unrun: local HTTP server attempts exited on timeout, and Chromium could not connect.

## Next Move
1. Fix keyboard handling: `e.key.toLower()` in `js/game.js` is syntactically valid but calls a nonexistent string method; use `toLowerCase()`.
2. Fix rendering: `GardenWorld.getDrawables()` returns props only, so render nearby NPCs and arenas separately; also verify camera transforms for `drawGround()`.
3. Check arena and battle completion result shapes, starter setup and UI hook behavior against existing implementations.
4. Run a browser smoke test and verify controls, language selection, saving/loading, and gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, setup/starter UI, gameplay DOM, and game script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Primary startup and integration code; runtime validation remains.
- `js/core.js`: State, mode options, saves, team/items, hooks, and audio APIs.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle flow and completion callback.
- `js/ui.js`: Panels and `uiHooks`.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, rendering, NPCs, arenas, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` positions the player at pixel coordinates `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`.
- World exposes `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; instances have `npcs[]` and `arenas[]`.
- `getDrawables(cam)` currently returns nearby props only. `drawGround()` draws in world coordinates, while `js/game.js` does not apply a camera translation before calling it.
- `world.drawMinimap` expects `discovered` as a `Set`; game state stores it as an array. `js/game.js` converts it when drawing.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Created `js/game.js` with setup, starter selection, movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saves, language switching, input/touch controls, and UI/battle hooks.
- Removed the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import from `js/ui.js`.
- `node --check` passes for `js/game.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/core.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/battle.js`.

### Active
- Fix and validate runtime integration between `js/game.js` and world/UI/battle APIs.

### Blocked
- Browser smoke test remains unrun: local HTTP server attempts exited on timeout, and Chromium could not connect.

## Next Move
1. Replace `e.key.toLower` and `e.key.toLower()` in `js/game.js` with `toLowerCase()`.
2. Fix rendering transforms: `GardenWorld.drawGround()` draws in world coordinates, but `drawGame()` does not translate the camera; render nearby NPCs and arenas separately because `getDrawables()` returns props only.
3. Reconcile `MODE_INFO` keys in `js/core.js` (`difficulty`, `catchRule`, etc.) with `js/game.js`’s `labelKey`, `tagKey`, `difficultyKey`, `livesKey`, and `catchKey` accesses.
4. Verify arena trainer names/team behavior, fast travel argument shape, starter setup, and battle-completion handling.
5. Run a browser smoke test covering controls, language selection, saving/loading, and gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entry screen, setup/starter UI, gameplay DOM, and game script reference.
- `js/game.js`: Primary startup and integration code; runtime validation remains.
- `js/core.js`: State, mode options, saves, team/items, hooks, and audio APIs.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle flow and completion callback.
- `js/ui.js`: Panels and `uiHooks`.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, rendering, NPCs, arenas, and encounter pools.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` positions the player at pixel coordinates `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`.
- World exposes `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; instances have `npcs[]` and `arenas[]`.
- `drawMinimap()` expects `discovered` as a `Set`; game state stores it as an array, and `js/game.js` converts it when drawing.
- `js/battle.js` completes through `hooks.onBattleEnd` with string results such as `'win'`, `'lose'`, `'whiteout'`, `'boss'`, and `'run'`; `js/game.js` currently checks `result?.won` and `result?.arenaId`.

## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Created `js/game.js` with setup, starter selection, movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saves, language switching, input/touch controls, and UI/battle hooks.
- Removed the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import from `js/ui.js`.
- `node --check` passes for `js/game.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/core.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/battle.js`.

### Active
- Fix runtime integration between `js/game.js` and world/UI/battle APIs.

### Blocked
- Browser smoke test remains unrun: previous local HTTP server attempts exited on timeout, and Chromium could not connect.

## Next Move
1. Replace `e.key.toLower` and `e.key.toLower()` in `js/game.js` with `toLowerCase()`.
2. Fix rendering transforms: `GardenWorld.drawGround()` draws in world coordinates, but `drawGame()` does not translate the camera; `getDrawables()` returns props only, so render nearby `world.npcs` and `world.arenas` separately.
3. Reconcile `MODE_INFO` keys in `js/core.js` (`difficulty`, `lives`, `catchRule`) with `js/game.js`’s `labelKey`, `tagKey`, `difficultyKey`, `livesKey`, and `catchKey`; `labelKey` is also used by mode cards.
4. Fix arena startup: `world.arenas` exposes `leader`, `team`, and `px`/`py`, but `interactArena()` currently uses `arena.name` and generates a new generic team instead of using the arena’s configured team.
5. Align `hooks.onBattleEnd` with `js/battle.js`: it receives result strings such as `'win'`, `'lose'`, `'whiteout'`, `'boss'`, and `'run'`, plus the battle object as a second argument—not `{ won, arenaId }`.
6. Check fast-travel argument/zone shape and whether starter setup/state behavior matches UI expectations.
7. Run a browser smoke test covering controls, language selection, saving/loading, exploration, encounters, and arenas.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Startup and primary integration code; runtime fixes remain.
- `js/core.js`: Mode metadata, state, saves, team/items, and hooks.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, rendering, NPCs, arenas, and encounter pools.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle flow and completion callback.
- `js/ui.js`: Panels and `uiHooks`.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `index.html`: Entry screen, setup/starter UI, gameplay DOM, and game script reference.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` positions the player at pixel coordinates `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`.
- World exposes `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; instances have `npcs[]` and `arenas[]`.
- `getDrawables()` only returns nearby props; `drawGround()` and `drawProp()` expect world-coordinate rendering.
- Arenas define leaders and teams in `ARENA_DEFS`; `buildArenas()` copies these into `world.arenas`.
- `drawMinimap()` expects `discovered` as a `Set`; game state stores it as an array, and `js/game.js` converts it when drawing.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Created `js/game.js` with setup, starter selection, movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saves, language switching, input/touch controls, and UI/battle hooks.
- Removed the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import from `js/ui.js`.
- `node --check` passes for `js/game.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/core.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/battle.js`.

### Active
- Fix runtime integration between `js/game.js` and world/UI/battle APIs.

### Blocked
- Browser smoke test remains unrun; prior local HTTP server attempts exited on timeout, and Chromium could not connect.

## Next Move
1. Replace `e.key.toLower` and `e.key.toLower()` in `js/game.js` with `toLowerCase()`.
2. Fix rendering transforms: `GardenWorld.drawGround()` draws in world coordinates, but `drawGame()` does not translate the camera; `getDrawables()` returns props only, so render nearby `world.npcs` and `world.arenas` separately.
3. Reconcile `MODE_INFO` keys in `js/core.js` (`difficulty`, `lives`, `catchRule`) with `js/game.js`’s `labelKey`, `tagKey`, `difficultyKey`, `livesKey`, and `catchKey`; `labelKey` is also used by mode cards.
4. Fix arena startup: `world.arenas` exposes `leader`, `team`, and `px`/`py`, but `interactArena()` currently uses `arena.name` and generates a new generic team instead of using the configured team.
5. Align `hooks.onBattleEnd` with `js/battle.js`: it receives result strings such as `'win'`, `'lose'`, `'whiteout'`, `'boss'`, and `'run'`, plus the battle object as a second argument—not `{ won, arenaId }`.
6. Check fast-travel argument/zone shape and whether starter setup/state behavior matches UI expectations.
7. Run a browser smoke test covering controls, language selection, saving/loading, exploration, encounters, and arenas.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Startup and primary integration code; runtime fixes remain.
- `js/core.js`: Mode metadata, state, saves, team/items, and hooks.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, rendering, NPCs, arenas, and encounter pools.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle flow and completion callback.
- `js/ui.js`: Panels and `uiHooks`.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `index.html`: Entry screen, setup/starter UI, gameplay DOM, and game script reference.
- `styles.css`: Responsive game styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` positions the player at pixel coordinates `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`.
- World exposes `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; instances have `npcs[]` and `arenas[]`.
- `getDrawables()` only returns nearby props; `drawGround()` and `drawProp()` expect world-coordinate rendering.
- Arenas define leaders and teams in `ARENA_DEFS`; `buildArenas()` copies these into `world.arenas`.
- `drawMinimap()` expects `discovered` as a `Set`; game state stores it as an array, and `js/game.js` converts it when drawing.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Created `js/game.js` with setup, starter selection, movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saves, language switching, input/touch controls, and UI/battle hooks.
- Removed the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import from `js/ui.js`.
- `node --check` passes for `js/game.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/core.js`, `js/world.js`, and `js/battle.js`.

### Active
- Fix runtime integration between `js/game.js` and world/UI/battle APIs.

### Blocked
- Browser smoke test remains unrun; prior local HTTP server attempts exited on timeout, and Chromium could not connect.

## Next Move
1. Replace `e.key.toLower` and `e.key.toLower()` in `js/game.js` with `toLowerCase()`.
2. Fix rendering transforms: `GardenWorld.drawGround()` draws in world coordinates, but `drawGame()` does not translate the camera; `getDrawables()` returns props only, so render nearby `world.npcs` and `world.arenas` separately.
3. Reconcile `MODE_INFO` keys in `js/core.js` (`difficulty`, `lives`, `catchRule`) with `js/game.js`’s `labelKey`, `tagKey`, `difficultyKey`, `livesKey`, and `catchKey`; `labelKey` is also used by mode cards.
4. Fix arena startup: `world.arenas` exposes `leader`, `team`, and `px`/`py`, but `interactArena()` currently uses `arena.name` and generates a new generic team instead of using the configured team.
5. Align `hooks.onBattleEnd` with `js/battle.js`: it receives result strings such as `'win'`, `'lose'`, `'whiteout'`, `'boss'`, and `'run'`, plus the battle object as a second argument—not `{ won, arenaId }`. Note that `js/battle.js` already marks arena wins in state before invoking the hook.
6. Fix fast travel: `js/ui.js` passes arena/heart objects to `uiHooks.fastTravel`, while `js/game.js` expects a zone ID; heart objects have no corresponding `world.zones` entry.
7. Check whether starter setup/state behavior matches UI expectations.
8. Run a browser smoke test covering controls, language selection, saving/loading, exploration, encounters, and arenas.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Startup and primary integration code; runtime fixes remain.
- `js/core.js`: Mode metadata, state, saves, team/items, and hooks.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, rendering, NPCs, arenas, and encounter pools.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle flow and completion callback.
- `js/ui.js`: Panels and `uiHooks`.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `index.html`: Entry screen, setup/starter UI, gameplay DOM, and game script reference.
- `styles.css`: Responsive game styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` positions the player at pixel coordinates `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`.
- World exposes `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; instances have `npcs[]` and `arenas[]`.
- `getDrawables()` only returns nearby props; `drawGround()` and `drawProp()` expect world-coordinate rendering.
- Arenas define leaders and teams in `ARENA_DEFS`; `buildArenas()` copies these into `world.arenas`.
- `drawMinimap()` expects `discovered` as a `Set`; game state stores it as an array, and `js/game.js` converts it when drawing.
- `js/battle.js` calls `hooks.onBattleEnd(result, battleObject)`; arena victory state is set in battle completion logic.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Created `js/game.js` with setup, starter selection, movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saves, language switching, input/touch controls, and UI/battle hooks.
- Removed the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import from `js/ui.js`; syntax checks previously passed for the main game modules.

### Active
- Fix runtime integration between `js/game.js` and world/UI/battle APIs.

### Blocked
- Browser smoke test remains unrun; prior local HTTP server attempts exited on timeout, and Chromium could not connect.

## Next Move
1. Replace `e.key.toLower` and `e.key.toLower()` in `js/game.js` with `toLowerCase()`.
2. Fix rendering transforms: `GardenWorld.drawGround()` draws in world coordinates, but `drawGame()` does not translate the camera; render nearby `world.npcs` and `world.arenas` separately because `getDrawables()` returns props only.
3. Reconcile `MODE_INFO` keys in `js/core.js` (`difficulty`, `lives`, `catchRule`) with `js/game.js`’s `labelKey`, `tagKey`, `difficultyKey`, `livesKey`, and `catchKey`; `labelKey` is also used by mode cards.
4. Fix arena startup: `world.arenas` exposes `leader`, `team`, and `px`/`py`, but `interactArena()` currently uses `arena.name` and generates a new generic team instead of using the configured team.
5. Align `hooks.onBattleEnd`: `js/battle.js` passes result strings (`'win'`, `'lose'`, `'whiteout'`, `'boss'`, and `'run'`) plus the battle object as a second argument—not `{ won, arenaId }`. Arena victory state is already marked before the hook.
6. Fix fast travel: `js/ui.js` passes arena/heart objects to `uiHooks.fastTravel`, while `js/game.js` expects a zone ID; heart objects have no corresponding `world.zones` entry.
7. Check whether starter setup/state behavior matches UI expectations.
8. Run a browser smoke test covering controls, language selection, saving/loading, exploration, encounters, and arenas.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Startup and primary integration code; runtime fixes remain.
- `js/core.js`: Mode metadata, state, saves, team/items, and hooks.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, rendering, NPCs, arenas, and encounter pools.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle flow and completion callback.
- `js/ui.js`: Panels and `uiHooks`.
- `index.html`: Entry screen, setup/starter UI, gameplay DOM, and game script reference.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive game styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` positions the player at pixel coordinates `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`.
- World exposes `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; instances have `npcs[]` and `arenas[]`.
- `drawGround()` and `drawProp()` expect world-coordinate rendering; `getDrawables()` only returns nearby props.
- `buildArenas()` copies arena definitions containing `leader`, `team`, `px`/`py`, and a `zone` identifier into `world.arenas`.
- `drawMinimap()` expects `discovered` as a `Set`; game state stores it as an array, and `js/game.js` converts it when drawing.
- `js/battle.js` marks arena wins in state before invoking `hooks.onBattleEnd(result, battleObject)`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Jardin as a playable Pokémon-inspired open-world browser game with gym arenas and multiple game modes.
- Support French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and other available languages.

## Requirements
- Include open-world exploration, gym arenas, and playable gameplay.
- Provide Random Hardcore, Random Classic, Nuzlocke, and the existing Garden Adventure modes.
- Make randomization of trainers, wild encounters, move types, and starters optional.
- Use PokeAPI data with attribution and keep the game an original Pokémon-inspired experience called “Jardin.”

## Decisions
- Use PokeAPI species, move, type, sprite, and cry data.
- Keep Garden Adventure alongside the additional modes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Generated PokeAPI data for 67 species and downloaded sprite and cry assets.
- Created the entry screen, responsive styling, translations, language utilities, and world-generation module.
- Added `js/core.js`, `js/battle.js`, and `js/ui.js` for game state, battles, and interface panels.
- Created `js/game.js` with setup, starter selection, movement, interactions, encounters, arenas, saves, language switching, input/touch controls, and UI/battle hooks.
- Removed the invalid `formatTimeSafe` import from `js/ui.js`; syntax checks previously passed for the main game modules.

### Active
- Fix runtime integration between `js/game.js` and world/UI/battle APIs.

### Blocked
- Browser smoke test remains unrun; prior local HTTP server attempts exited on timeout, and Chromium could not connect.

## Next Move
1. Replace `e.key.toLower` and `e.key.toLower()` in `js/game.js` with `toLowerCase()`.
2. Fix rendering transforms: `GardenWorld.drawGround()` and `drawProp()` draw in world coordinates, but `drawGame()` does not translate the camera; render nearby `world.npcs` and `world.arenas` separately because `getDrawables()` returns props only.
3. Fix arena proximity: `world.arenas` has `px`/`py` in pixels, but `findNearby()` checks `arena.x`/`arena.y` in tile coordinates.
4. Reconcile interaction handling: arena leaders and regular trainers are stored in `world.npcs`, but `interactNpc()` currently only handles shop/healer specially and otherwise displays dialogue; route leaders/trainers to battles.
5. Reconcile `MODE_INFO` keys in `js/core.js` (`difficulty`, `lives`, `catchRule`) with `js/game.js`’s `labelKey`, `tagKey`, `difficultyKey`, `livesKey`, and `catchKey`; `labelKey` is also used by mode cards.
6. Fix arena startup to use the configured leader/team/reward in `world.arenas` or the associated leader NPC rather than generic teams and nonexistent `arena.name`.
7. Align `hooks.onBattleEnd`: `js/battle.js` passes result strings (`'win'`, `'lose'`, `'whiteout'`, `'boss'`, and `'run'`) plus the battle object as a second argument—not `{ won, arenaId }`. Arena victory state is already marked before the hook.
8. Fix fast travel: `js/ui.js` passes arena/heart objects to `uiHooks.fastTravel`, while `js/game.js` expects a zone ID; heart objects have no corresponding `world.zones` entry.
9. Check whether starter setup/state behavior matches UI expectations, then run a browser smoke test covering controls, language selection, saving/loading, exploration, encounters, and arenas.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Startup and primary integration code; runtime fixes remain.
- `js/core.js`: Mode metadata, state, saves, team/items, and hooks.
- `js/world.js`: World generation, rendering, NPCs, arenas, and encounter pools.
- `js/battle.js`: Battle flow and completion callback.
- `js/ui.js`: Panels and `uiHooks`.
- `index.html`: Entry screen, setup/starter UI, gameplay DOM, and game script reference.
- `js/i18n.js`: Translation utilities and language selection.
- `styles.css`: Responsive game styling.
- `tools/build-data.mjs`: Modified data-generation script.
- `assets/fonts/`: Added font assets.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `tools/build-data.mjs` is modified, and `assets/fonts/`, `index.html`, `js/`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- `createState()` positions the player at pixel coordinates `(70 * 32, 100 * 32)`.
- World exposes `drawGround`, `getDrawables`, `drawProp`, `isSolid`, `isTall`, `zoneAt`, `drawMinimap`, and `drawFullMap`; instances have `npcs[]` and `arenas[]`.
- `getDrawables()` only returns nearby props; arena definitions include `leader`, `team`, and pixel coordinates `px`/`py`.
- `drawMinimap()` expects `discovered` as a `Set`; game state stores it as an array, and `js/game.js` converts it when drawing.
- `js/battle.js` marks arena wins in state before invoking `hooks.onBattleEnd(result, battleObject)`.
